checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No second mandatory fee for staff, facilities or overhead appears; only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead is described as added to selections.
No D-embalming disclosure is printed on the list, so placement next to the embalming price does not apply.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered and includes an option with container provided by the purchaser; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists what is included, and no separate cash-advance charge for the crematory fee is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered item appears only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase; the selection disclosure language is the required wording.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and no required disclosure is shown in a way that is hard to notice.
